## What this case checks

Confirm that vector geometries in WGS84 can be reprojected to the raster grid CRS and successfully rasterized.

## Risk types covered

- [`rasterization_alignment`](../risk/rasterization-alignment.md)
- [`reprojection_error`](../risk/reprojection-error.md)

## Expected behavior

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_valid_geometry` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `4326` |
| `expected_geometry_types` | `Polygon` |

## Notes

A WGS84 polygon that overlaps the bundled `geotiff_utm_boundary` raster after reprojection to EPSG:32633.
